product.description: Considerată cea mai gravă după marele crah din 1929, actuala criză financiară a intrat în faza acută în septembrie 2008. Fannie Mae şi Freddie Mac, două instituţii americane de credit ipotecar susţinute de guvernul SUA, au fost la un pas de faliment. Bănci puternice precum Lehman Brothers şi Merrill Lynch s-au prăbuşit, în timp ce Rezerva Federală căuta disperată soluţii. Panica a luat amploare şi s-a propagat ca un val seismic în întreaga lume, din Europa până în Japonia. Chiar şi acum, la peste doi ani de la izbucnirea crizei, efectele ei încă se fac simţite. Care au fost, însă, cauzele care au determinat colapsul financiar? Cartea de faţă vă propune o analiză a ideologiei economice americane din ultimii 40 de ani, de la epoca liberal-keynesiană până la teoria pieţei libere aparţinând Şcolii de la Chicago. Morris este convins că paşii greşiţi făcuţi în timpul administraţiilor Nixon, Ford şi Carter, dar şi politicile Rezervei Federale au adus Statele Unite în derivă economică, au provocat căderea dolarului şi declinul sectorului de afaceri american. Totul a culminat cu explozia balonului imobiliar a creditelor ipotecare subprime.   Fost bancher şi avocat, Charles R. Morris este unul dintre cei mai buni analişti financiari ai momentului. Publicată la începutul anului 2008, cartea de faţă este o adevărată profeţie a crizei ce urma să izbucnească, dar şi un ghid al celor care vor să descopere dedesubturile lumii finanţelor mondiale. De acelaşi autor a mai apărut, la Editura Litera, Criza economică şi profeţii ei.

# Criza de un Trilion de Dolari: Unveiling the Secrets of Modern Financial Collapse

**By Litera** | **Category:** Non-Fiction

Understanding the roots and mechanics of modern economic downturns is crucial for any reader interested in global finance. *Criza de un Trilion de Dolari* (The Crisis of a Trillion Dollars) offers an exhaustive, deep-dive analysis into one of the most profound financial events of the 21st centuryâthe global financial crisis that began in September 2008.

This bestselling book is not just a history; it is a comprehensive examination of the ideological shifts and policy decisions that led to the collapse. Whether you are an economist, investor, or simply curious about how complex financial systems fail, this volume promises unparalleled insight into global money markets.

***

## The Genesis of the Crisis: A Global Overview

The book meticulously recounts the sequence of events that defined the 2008 meltdown. It details how major American mortgage credit institutions, such as Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, faced imminent collapse, while powerful banking giants like Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch plummeted into bankruptcy. As panic swept across continentsâfrom Europe to Japanâthe search for solutions became a desperate race led by central banks worldwide.

The author argues that the tremors of this crisis, which occurred more than two years after its initial outbreak, still resonate today. The core question addressed in the book is: **What were the underlying causes that dictated this massive financial collapse?**

## Analyzing Economic Failure: From Liberalism to Free Markets

*Criza de un Trilion de Dolari* provides readers with a thorough analysis of American economic ideology over the past four decades. The narrative traces the evolution from the liberal-Keynesian school of thought up through the emergence of free-market theories associated with the Chicago School.

The author, Charles R. Morris, who has backgrounds as both a banker and an attorney, presents a compelling argument: that systemic failures were not accidental. He contends that flawed policies implemented during the administrations of Nixon, Ford, and Carter, coupled with actions by the Federal Reserve, drove the United States into economic decline.

The book culminates its investigation by detailing how these combined factors triggered the dramatic decline of the dollar and initiated the collapse of American industryâa climax fueled by the bursting of the subprime mortgage bubble.

## Why This Book is Essential Reading

Published at the beginning of 2008, this work was described as a genuine prophecy of the coming crisis, making it both a critical historical record and an invaluable guide for those seeking to understand the hidden mechanics of global finance. Morris leverages his decades of expertise, offering readers more than just a recitation of factsâhe provides a framework for understanding systemic risk and financial vulnerability.

If you are looking for a definitive analysis that cuts through institutional narratives to reveal the true vulnerabilities of world finance, this book is an indispensable resource.

**Q: Is this book purely theoretical?**
A: No. The author synthesizes historical policy decisions, banking practices, and economic theories into a cohesive narrative, drawing from his professional experience as both a banker and an attorney.

**Q: Who is the target audience for this analysis?**
A: While it delves into complex financial concepts, the book is written to provide insight for anyone interested in macroeconomics, global finance, or political history.
